description:
Outside the three steps: for a customer who arrives with a Sigo link they already have.

Says what a Sigo link points at, how far that application has got, and the one thing the customer has to do next. Call it when someone shows up with a link — from an email, a text, or their own notes — and asks for help finishing.

Pass only the Sigo link or code they shared. It resolves the short link, the long one and a bare code.

It reads only: it opens nothing on the customer's behalf, and asking twice changes nothing. It reports no price, carrier or personal detail, because Sigo does not send any — whoever holds a link gets this same answer, so there is nothing here that identifies its owner. Say the `message` as given rather than composing one.

locale.description: The language to write the returned `message` in: the customer's own, es or en.

pasted_link.description: Only the Sigo link or code the customer shared (a sigoseguros.com link or a short code), not the rest of their message. Stray punctuation around it is fine; do not guess at a link the customer did not provide.

name: resolve_application_link

message.description: What to tell the customer, already written in their language. Say this rather than composing your own: it is the only description of the application Sigo has checked, and it deliberately states no price, carrier or personal detail because none was read.

next_step.description: The single next action, as a value. `message` is the wording for it.

state.description: How far the application has got. Coarse on purpose.

url.description: The link to hand back so the customer can continue, or null when nothing resolved. Use this URL rather than the one the customer pasted.

title: Read a Sigo link the customer already has
